units: B. Bath. 78ᵇ ואמאי קרי ליה סיח שמהלך אחר ס׳ נאה and why do they call a young ass sayyaḥ? Because it follows a persuasive talk (of its driver, whereas the old ass must be struck).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 78b:14">Ib.</cite> (play on <he>עיר סיחון</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 21:27">Num. XXI, 27</cite>) <he>אם משים … כְּעַיִר שמהלך אחר ס׳ נאה</he> if a man makes himself like (is as obedient as) the young ass that follows &c.

<cite ref="Numbers 21:27">Ib.</cite> (play on <cite ref="P01235"><he>ער</he></cite> ib. 28) <he>זה המהלך אחר יצרו … ס׳ נאה</he> that is he who follows his evil inclination as the young ass follows &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94a:12">Snh. 94ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ס̇נח̇ר̇י̇ב̇</he>) <he>שסִיֹחָתוֹ ר̇י̇ב̇</he> whose talk is strife.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71b:2">Kidd. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שסיחתו בבבל</he> he whose conversation shows that he is a Babylonian.

<cite ref="Chagigah 5b:7">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 4:13">Am. IV, 13</cite>) <he>אפי׳ ש׳ יתירה וכ׳</he> even superfluous talk between husband and wife is brought up against man in his hour of death; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:7">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>אפי׳ ש׳ קלה שאדם משיח וכ׳</he> even frivolous talk &c.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 764:13">Yalk. Num. 764</cite> <he>שיחת כנענים</he> the language of the Canaanites; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סִיחוֹת</he>, <cite ref="O00806"><he>שִׂ׳</he></cite>. Y. Gitt. IX, end, 50ᵈ (<cite ref="U00001"><he>ש׳</he></cite>) <he>ס׳ בני אדם משיחין</he> when people talk what people say (i.e. when you can trace the rumor; v. Bab.
